AI가 제안한 아이디어 세 가지를 비교했습니다: Comparing three ideas suggested by AI
아직 아이디어가 없는 경우에는 관심 분야나 해본 일, 생활 속 불편에서: For students without an idea yet, we demonstrated how to start with interests, past experience or everyday problems. The process was to ask AI for three different ideas, then compare their customers, revenue models, initial costs and implementation difficulty.
하나를 골랐다면 누가 비용을 지불할지, 기존 서비스와 무엇이 다른지, 작: After choosing an idea, ask who would pay for it, how it differs from existing services and how to test it on a small scale. Class notes and practice prompts are available in the resources below.
We stood the game boxes upright and laid out character materials in front. We also opened The Festival Where the Snake Died to display its contents, so visitors could see the physical size and print quality beyond the cover images online.
실습 자료에는 이 조건을 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 요청문 예시와 번역 과제를 넣: The practice materials included adaptable prompts and translation exercises. The aim was to adjust the length and wording for different publishing formats, even when describing the same destination.
문구를 다듬은 뒤에는 이미지와 함께 웹페이지로 만드는 실습을 진행했습니다: After refining the text, participants practiced combining it with images on a webpage. They organized the page around the tourism topic they had chosen earlier.
사건이 벌어진 이유와 인물별 행동을 정리합니다. 결말을 설명하는 데 필요: We outline why the incident happened and what each character did, then check that earlier scenes provide the information needed to explain the ending.
인물마다 알고 있는 정보와 공개할 단서를 나눕니다. 서로 질문하고 자료를: We assign each character their information and clues to reveal, then check that players can reason through the case by asking questions and comparing materials.
플레이 중 막히는 부분을 확인합니다. 판단에 필요한 단서가 빠졌거나 너무: We identify where players get stuck. If a necessary clue is missing or arrives too late, we revise its content and timing.
인물 시트·한영 단서 카드·안내 영상을 미리 볼 수 있습니다. 게임은 4: Preview the character sheets, bilingual clue cards and guide video. The game is designed for four players; the four-session lesson plan will be reviewed in the pilot.

After Moseori Theater closes for the last time, its owner is found dead in the projection room. Play as detective Jeong Hae-on, interview the people still there, and examine the scene and records.
수집한 단서로 판단과 근거를 제시하고, 부족한 정보를 다시 조사하며 사건: Build an argument from the clues you collect, then return to investigate any missing information.

발견한 기록을 읽고 떠날 방법을 선택한다. 결정에 따라 다섯 결말로 나뉜: Read the records and choose how to leave. Your decisions lead to five endings.

게임을 만드는 과정을 소개했습니다: Introducing how we make our games
수업은 단서공방의 작품 소개로 시작했습니다. 게임 아이디어를 기획하고,: We began with Project DullG’s games, introducing the process of developing an idea, writing and printing the materials, and producing a physical game.
이어서 울릉도에서 좋아하는 것, 바꾸고 싶은 것, 해보고 싶은 일을 이야: We then discussed what students liked about Ulleungdo, what they wanted to change, and what they wanted to try. The presentation included an exercise for finding game ideas in familiar places and experiences by writing down the place, people, situation, and rules.
모둠별로 역할을 맡아 게임을 했습니다: Taking roles and playing in groups
Students formed groups and took roles in a murder mystery game. They read the clues in their materials and exchanged information with their group as they worked through the case.
내 아이디어를 적은 뒤 AI에 질문하기: Writing an idea before asking AI
AI 실습은 자신의 아이디어를 먼저 적는 순서로 준비했습니다. 어떤 장소: The AI exercise started with writing down an idea. The task was to decide where something happens and what happens, then ask AI questions to develop the title, setting, roles, mission, and clues.
The presentation used a game set on an Ulleung cruise as an example. It showed how to turn a topic into a game, then scale it down to an activity that could be tried in 15 minutes.
마지막 과제는 울릉도 소재 세 가지와 콘텐츠 제목, 한 줄 소개, 다음에: The final task was to write down three Ulleungdo topics, a content title, a one-line description, and a next step. The materials also covered preparing introductory copy and a preview to share an idea and ask for feedback.

AI를 처음 사용하는 분들도 따라 하실 수 있도록 AI의 기본 개념과 요: We started with basic AI concepts and prompt writing so that first-time users could follow along. The first exercise was writing a one-line introduction to Ulleungdo.
소개할 관광 소재를 고르고 AI에 문구를 요청한 뒤, 나온 내용을 확인했: We chose a tourism topic, asked AI for copy, and checked its response. We then worked on the promotional copy and images before putting them into a web page.
SNS와 포스터에 맞게 문구 바꾸기: Adapting copy for social media and posters
같은 성인봉을 소개하더라도 SNS 게시물과 관광 포스터에 쓸 문구는 길이: A social media post and a tourism poster need different lengths of copy, even when both introduce Seonginbong. We explained how to specify the audience, intended use, and number of options in a prompt.
자료에는 한 줄 소개, SNS 게시물, 관광 포스터에 맞춘 요청문 예시와: The materials included sample prompts for one-line introductions, social media posts, and tourism posters, along with translation exercises. They provided practice in making requests suited to where the copy would be used.
문구와 이미지를 웹페이지에 담았습니다: Putting the copy and images into a web page
앞에서 만든 문구와 이미지를 모아 관광 정보를 소개하는 웹페이지를 만드는: We also covered building a tourism information page with the copy and images from the earlier exercises. The session included organizing its contents and practicing how to make the page.

The lesson materials follow the same sequence: take a role, read clues, explain information to one another, and piece together the incident.
AI에 묻기 전에 내 아이디어부터 적기: Writing your own idea before asking AI
발표자료에서는 울릉 크루즈에서 벌어진 일을 배경으로 게임 아이디어를 떠올: The presentation uses an incident on an Ulleung cruise as an example for developing a game idea. The exercise expands a topic, turns it into a game, then narrows it to an activity that can be tried in 15 minutes. It practices reducing an AI-generated concept to a manageable activity instead of using a long setting unchanged.
수업 자료의 마지막 목표는 울릉도 소재 세 가지, 콘텐츠 제목, 한 줄: The final task in the materials is to record three Ulleungdo topics, a content title, a one-line introduction, and a next step. The aim is to leave with a concept for further work rather than submit a finished product.
발표자료에는 다른 사람에게 아이디어를 설명할 소개 문구와 미리보기, 피드: The presentation also covers introductory copy, previews, and feedback for explaining an idea to other people. You can revisit the lesson in order using the web presentation below. A PDF is available for those who want to keep a copy.
교육 자료는 지역 주민과 AI를 처음 접하는 분들을 대상으로 구성했습니다: The materials were designed for local residents and people new to AI. They explain AI and how to write a prompt, then start with a one-line introduction to Ulleungdo. The sequence begins with a short request and checking its output, rather than creating a long result all at once.
누구에게 보여줄 문구인지 정하기: Deciding who the copy is for

예를 들어 성인봉을 소개하는 SNS 문구와 관광 포스터에 들어갈 문구는: For example, a social media post about Seonginbong and copy for a tourism poster need different lengths and structures. The materials include examples for these uses and translation exercises. Practice is organized around tourism content to create, rather than a list of AI features.
